subject: Request: Partner Trial Supplement & Compliance Checklist for GreenCloud Pilot
messages:
From: Samir Rana <samir.rana@greencloud.io>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot top-up request + SCQ for GreenCloud Redwood PoC

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at GreenCloud is excited to move forward with the POC next month. We have a tight timeline with a customer proof, and our technical team has asked whether Redwood can extend the trial allocation by an additional 20k token-equivalent (to cover the higher prompt volume during the demo week).

Also attaching our short Security & Compliance Questionnaire (SCQ) so your security team can confirm data handling expectations. Can you confirm if Redwood needs anything else to approve the supplement (e.g., signed MPA, procurement contact for billing card-on-file)?

Attachments: GCS_Pilot_SCQ.xlsx

Best,
Samir Rana
Partnerships, GreenCloud Solutions
procurement@greencloud.io
www.greencloud.io
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 10:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up request + SCQ for GreenCloud Redwood PoC

Hi Samir — thanks for the SCQ and the context.

Quick answers:
- We can potentially accommodate a 20k token supplement for the pilot week, subject to a short approvals checklist.
- Required items for a fast path: signed Master Pilot Agreement (MPA) or signature on the standard SOW addendum, procurement contact for invoicing (if any), and the SCQ readout from our security reviewer.

Looping in Lauren (partnerships ops) and Vivek (dedicated partner allocations) to confirm availability on our end and to document the approval flow. Lauren — can you take the lead on the eligibility/charging terms? Vivek — can you confirm whether we have burst capacity for the week of Jan 8th?

I also attached the internal MPA draft we typically use for co-funded pilots to speed signatures. If GreenCloud can countersign, we can flag this for priority provisioning.

Attachments referenced: redwood-mpa-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Channel Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 04 Dec 2028 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up request + SCQ for GreenCloud Redwood PoC

Samir — appreciate the SCQ and the clear ask. Two quick items from ops:

1) Approval: We approved a one-time 20k token supplement for the pilot week conditional on (a) signed MPA or signed SOW addendum, and (b) completion of the security exceptions form (if any controls in the SCQ are non-standard).
2) Procurement: Please provide a procurement contact for invoicing and share the PO process if you require billing against a PO. Otherwise we will provision the supplement as a community-sponsored grant and invoice afterwards if you opt for a paid extension.

Next steps I recommend:
- GreenCloud countersigns the attached MPA (redwood-mpa-draft.pdf) and returns to Monica (cc'd) — Monica will manage DocuSign routing and confirm billing terms.
- Security: Monica, can you run the SCQ with the security team and flag any deviations?

Monica will follow up with DocuSign and confirm the provisioning window once we have the signed doc. Samir, copying Monica so she has the right contact.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Partnerships Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
